subject: sounds
title: Same middle sound
about: Hear a short word and tap the word with the same middle sound, with no letters shown. This is the by-ear partner of the Short vowel sounds level and completes NC RF.1.3.c (isolating the medial vowel) using only the five short vowels of CKLA Unit 1.
tip: Stretch the middle of the cue word (caaat) and then stretch each choice the same way.

cards.q: Which word has the same middle sound as cat?
cards.note: The middle sound in cat and bag is the same: short a, like in hat.
